text: So sorry to be messaging about this at this time of night, I know you probably have far more serious things to deal with. My son is 5 and he just won't settle to sleep tonight. He's been up and down out of bed for about two hours now. In himself he seems fine though, he's been chatting to me, asked for a drink and some toast, played a bit with his cars when he was meant to be in bed. The other thing is he hasn't done a poo for three days now and he's been quite grumpy about it, he says he doesn't want to go and gets cross when I suggest sitting on the toilet. I don't know if the two things are connected, like if he's uncomfortable and that's why he can't get off to sleep. His mum usually handles this kind of thing and she's working nights this week so I'm a bit out of my depth. Is there anything I should be doing for the constipation tonight, or anything that would help him settle? Again really sorry for bothering you, I just didn't want to get it wrong.
